metadata.description: A personal collection of Claude Code plugins and skills.

plugins.name: diagrams
plugins.description: Engineering illustrations as static PNG/SVG for reports, issue trackers and clients: architecture, step-by-step processes, status boards, roadmaps/gantt, incident write-ups. A Python SVG kit with three themes (light, graphite, night), bundled IBM Plex fonts, a layout linter (overlapping labels, text outside boxes, arrows through boxes, tiny type in the preview, orphan words) and a palette checker (contrast, colour blindness, greyscale). A subagent draws; before it starts the user picks Opus or Sonnet.
